new_findings: Low-severity sibling check for the correctness lens: the memo stores each keyed record's inToday/inWeek at scan time. It is invalidated only by computedForDay, size and mtime, so a record that drifts past sevenDaysAgo during the day keeps inWeek=true until the day rolls over.
